nodes.label: NewEra Logo (Light Theme)
nodes.description: The NewEra365 brand logo for use on light backgrounds. Displays 'NEWERA' in bold black uppercase lettering with a stylized green-and-black candlestick chart icon integrated into the letter 'N', representing the forex/CFD trading brand identity. White/transparent background. Used as the site header logo in light-mode or on white/light-colored surfaces.

nodes.label: Candlestick Chart Icon (Logo Emblem)
nodes.description: Small candlestick chart graphic embedded within the 'N' of the NEWERA wordmark. Contains green and black/dark candles, symbolising financial markets and trading. This is the brand's logomark/emblem component.
